# QCT Studio

> QCT Studio builds evidence-led digital growth systems for established businesses across Albania, North Macedonia, Kosovo and Serbia.

QCT Studio combines market-specific websites, e-commerce, SEO/GEO/AEO, conversion journeys, CRM and practical AI automation. Work is organized around three connected layers: Acquire demand, Convert intent and Operate follow-up. Scope and delivery timing depend on the business, market and technical requirements; QCT Studio does not publish fixed-duration guarantees.

## Primary market hubs

- [Albania](https://qctstudio.com/markets/albania/): Digital growth priorities, evidence and recommended system architecture for businesses targeting Albania.
- [North Macedonia](https://qctstudio.com/markets/north-macedonia/): Multilingual discovery, trust and operational priorities for the North Macedonian market.
- [Kosovo](https://qctstudio.com/markets/kosovo/): Mobile, social-to-owned-channel and diaspora-aware growth priorities for Kosovo.
- [Serbia](https://qctstudio.com/markets/serbia/): Search, commerce, trust and CRM priorities for the Serbian market.

Each market hub is also available in Albanian (/sq/), Macedonian (/mk/) and Serbian (/sr/). English is the default language.

## Diagnostic

- [Regional Growth Diagnostic](https://qctstudio.com/regional-growth-diagnostic/): A structured intake covering target markets, current digital stage, commercial priorities and operational constraints. It is a qualification and planning tool, not an automated performance promise.

## Services

- [Website Design](https://qctstudio.com/website-design/): Market-led websites built around a specific business, audience and conversion path.
- [E-commerce](https://qctstudio.com/e-commerce/): Product discovery, mobile shopping, checkout and manageable order flows.
- [WhatsApp Commerce](https://qctstudio.com/whatsapp-commerce/): Clearer sales and service journeys from web or campaign interest into WhatsApp.
- [SEO & GEO Performance](https://qctstudio.com/seo-performance/): Technical SEO, entity clarity, structured content and answer-ready pages for traditional and AI search.
- [Meta Ads Landing Pages](https://qctstudio.com/meta-ads-landing-pages/): Focused landing pages aligned with campaign intent.
- [AI Automation](https://qctstudio.com/ai-automation/): Human-controlled automation for lead routing, repetitive operations and CRM workflows.

## Evidence policy and selected work

QCT Studio separates public observation, verified responsibility and measured outcome. Performance metrics, client attribution and delivery scope are published only when supportable.

- [Selected Work](https://qctstudio.com/work/): The evidence-led work collection.
- [CTSEG Evidence Review](https://qctstudio.com/work/ctseg/): A review of CTSEG’s live multilingual trade platform and its verified founder-level venture connection. The page does not claim an agency delivery scope or commercial results.
- HEADWEAR is presented as a multilingual commerce case. Public-status reviews without verified attribution are intentionally excluded from search indexing.
